{{Quote|What’s a kick setting?''"<br />"''It's something ISB ships are sometimes equipped with. Engaging it jumps your hyperdrive speed about twenty percent.|Daric LaRone to Mara Jade|<ref name="Choices of One">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
A '''kick setting''', also known as a '''hyperdrive kick setting''', was a feature installed on some [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that increased its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] speed by approximately twenty percent when engaged.<ref name="Choices of One" />
